# Adventurous Systems

> Adventurous Systems is a research-led consultancy that builds Web3- and AI-enabled digital twins unifying design, construction, and operations data for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. Founded in 2023 by Dr Theo Dounas, it bridges peer-reviewed academic research with practical industry delivery across digital twins, blockchain, and AI advisory.

Adventurous Systems Ltd is based in Edinburgh, UK, and serves clients globally. Its work is grounded in £375,000+ of combined research funding (EPSRC, Scottish Enterprise, Interface/SFC) and active participation in the European Council on Computing in Construction (EC3) and the Construction Blockchain Consortium (CBC). Founder Dr Theo Dounas is a registered architect (UK, Greece), EC3 board member, and author of *Blockchain for Construction* (Springer, 2022).

## Services
- [What We Do](https://www.adventurous.systems/what-we-do.html): Digital twin integration, blockchain for construction, and AI readiness advisory services
- [Digital Twin Integration](https://www.adventurous.systems/what-we-do.html#digital-twins): Web3-enabled digital twins that unify design, construction, and operations data
- [Blockchain for Construction](https://www.adventurous.systems/what-we-do.html#blockchain): Smart contracts for verification, transparency, and circular material tracking
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://www.adventurous.systems/assessment.html): Two-week engagement scoring AEC firms across six AI-readiness dimensions

## Work
- [Our Work](https://www.adventurous.systems/our-work.html): Pilots and builds in material passports, circular construction, and decentralised AEC delivery
- [TRACE Marketplace](https://www.adventurous.systems/our-work.html): Scottish Government-funded blockchain marketplace for reusable construction materials

## Platforms
- [AFlow](https://aflow.adventurous.systems): Node-based AI design studio for architects — connect text, image, 3D, and reasoning nodes on one canvas into a governed design process with full authorship tracking and IFC/BIM export (live, invite-only)
- [Data Hard Hats: AEC Unlocked](https://datahardhats.adventurous.systems): Free, Scottish Government-funded programme helping Scottish AEC SMEs unlock the value in their data and build confidence with AI, across four regional cohorts
